claim: an app's two native Claude accounts each name their own folder to the pinned engine, a slow probe on one leaves the other ready, and removing one drops only its folder

steps.start: Fake gateway, empty account index; deterministic native subprocess fixtures; no real credentials
steps: Add two anthropic-cli accounts in place, each signed in at its own native folder
List both through their bindings; the engine seals and activates nothing
K2: the gateway is given a folder table naming one folder per account agent, paths only
K2: a slow probe on A leaves B ready and A bound
Cancel a re-auth of B; B keeps its binding and folder
Sign B out in its own folder; B reads signed out, A stays ready
K2: reading and signing out never unpublish a row
Remove B; only B folder is logged out and dropped, and its table row with it
steps.result: PASS: durable native binding, list/status/re-auth/logout through it, and the published folder table the pinned engine runs each account on; the engine child itself is held by packages/openclaw/test/engine/native-binding.test.ts (npm run test:engine); no principal dedup, keyring or live-account claim

verdicts.seen: I read all 9 entries. The capture reports "one row per account agent" with "that account own folder", a slow probe leaving "both still bound", and removal that "dropped B folder only" while "A kept its login". It also reports B's table row removed. Engine-child verification is referenced rather than shown directly.
